subject.title: System prompt should prefer Skill tool over read when available

question: Should native OpenClaw prompt guidance prefer a plugin-provided Skill loader by raw tool name, or only prefer a loader that advertises an explicit trusted skill-loading capability?
rationale: The requested behavior changes skill instructions from direct file reads to plugin tool responses, which affects prompt authority, plugin trust, and user upgrade expectations beyond a mechanical wording edit.

options.title: Require Explicit Loader Capability
options.body: Add or reuse a generic plugin capability or manifest/runtime marker and have prompt guidance prefer only that approved loader while preserving read fallback for other tools named Skill.

options.title: Adopt Tool-Name Convention
options.body: Treat a normalized Skill tool name as the supported contract and document that convention for plugin authors, accepting the collision and trust-boundary risk.

options.title: Wait For Router Direction
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide whether the local_skill_route design or a broader skill-router API should replace direct Skill-tool preference.

recommendation.title: Require Explicit Loader Capability
recommendation.body: Add or reuse a generic plugin capability or manifest/runtime marker and have prompt guidance prefer only that approved loader while preserving read fallback for other tools named Skill.
